payload.artist_html: Longrich, Nicholas R., Angel Alejandro Ramirez Velasco, Jim Kirkland, Andrés Eduardo Bermúdez Torres, and Claudia Inés Serrano-Brañas.
payload.description_html: Figure 18. A panoply of kritosaurs is known from the late Cretaceous of the Western Interior. Coahuilasaurus lipani IGM 6685, Gryposaurus monumentensis RAM 6786, Gryposaurus notabilis ROM 873; Gryposaurus latidens MOR 478, Rhinorex condrupus BYU 13528, “Gryposaurus” Alcatel TMM 46033-1, Kritosaurus navajovius AMNH 5799, Anasazisaurus horneri BYU 12950.
